The PiG A man from Australia contacted me one morning about 3am. As usual I was up and he proceeded to ask me if I knew about the British "Pig" amp that Ronno played in his Glam Rock phase. After a long discussion the Menatone Custom Shop PiG was born. Based on an incredibly rare, high power British amp, the PiG is simply oozing with fat, ripping rock, and grissly, thick, bluesy goodness. This new 2025 PiG takes the internal switches for presence boost and cut and puts them on a toggle switch on top.  Also all top mounted jacks now. ​ ​ Build time is approx. 4-6 weeks 219 Add to Cart DEMO for some reason youtube  videos are not working on the site... i am trying to figure it out. sources.excerpt: The Pig by Menatone | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Menatone The Pig LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE BOOSTER EQUALIZER Description A man from Australia contacted me one morning about 3am. As usual I was up and he proceeded to ask me if I knew about the British "Pig" amp that Ronno played in his Glam Rock phase. After a long discussion the Menatone Custom Shop PiG was born. Based on an incredibly rare, high power British amp, the PiG is simply oozing with fat, ripping rock, and grissly, thick, bluesy goodness. This new circuit board PiG is in a smaller enclosure with internal voltage doubling for a bigger sound with more headroom. Same circuit as the original with all of the same parts at a much better price. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Menatone PiG Back to results Menatone PiG Overdrive Distortion Amp-in-a-box drive after a rare British 'Pig' amp, for fat, gristly rock and blues tones. The PiG is an overdrive and distortion voiced after a rare British 'Pig' amplifier used in glam rock, aimed at fat, ripping rock tones and thick, gristly blues grind. A presence boost-and-cut toggle, top-mounted on the current version, shifts the top-end response to match different amps and rooms. Rather than a transparent overdrive it's a colored, amp-style drive with its own strong midrange voice, built for classic and hard rock rhythm and lead work. It's hand-built to order in the USA, point-to-point wired.
